newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Embraer sees smaller loss - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Embraer sees smaller loss - report.

text.p: Brazil's aircraft manufacturer Embraer expects to reduce losses to less than $50 million in 1996 against the $300 million loss posted last year, Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper said
No Embraer official was immediately available to comment on the report.
Gazeta quoted Embraer President Mauricio Botelho as saying the better 1996 results would be the result of restructuring, rising productivity and higher revenues.
Embraer also was counting on sales of its new jet EMB-145 to improve its bottom line. The company has already received 63 orders for the new aircraft, the newspaper said.
Embraer expects revenues to increase by five percent in 1996 to $400 million, it said.
